It's not a bug, it's a missing check. The fix wasn't trusting the screen harder. The fix was to stop trusting the screen. The write travels through the form. The confirmation doesn't. This isn't just a tool but a process. Teams want proof, not promises.

The banner said it was saved. It wasn't. Speed isn't the point. Accuracy is.
